summary: Ran EE-10 test suite for WF-02. Discovered and fixed a BLOCKER: engine_test.zig used relative @import paths that escape the Zig 0.16 module root, causing the test-engine step to fail with compile errors. Fixed by: (1) updating engine_test.zig to import via named bpm module using @import("bpm").engine and @import("bpm").tasks, removing the unused routes import; (2) moving bpm_src_mod declaration before engine_tests in build.zig; (3) removing the duplicate bpm_src_mod declaration in the integration tests section; (4) adding run_engine_tests to the main test step. After the fix: zig build exits 0, zig build test passes 100/189 tests (89 skipped integration tests), zig build test-engine passes all 15 engine unit tests including 12 EE-10-specific type/struct/error-mapping tests. Integration tests TC-EE-10-01 through TC-EE-10-06 are properly implemented in tests/integration/instance_error_test.zig but skip without BPM_TEST_DB_URL in this environment.
